body:
Hello team, congratulations on publishing ASVS v5.0.0!

I am starting the translation of the latest version into Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). This issue is intended to notify the OWASP team and community that the translation is underway and to align with the official contribution process.

I have read the CONTRIBUTING.md and will follow the recommended steps:
- Fork the repository
- Copy the `/5.0/en` folder to `/5.0/pt`
- Translate the Markdown files, preserving the exact structure, numbering, and terminology

Once complete, I will open a Pull Request targeting the `v5.0.0` branch.

If anyone from the Portuguese-speaking community is interested in contributing, feel free to collaborate!

Please let me know if there’s anything else I should do or share.

comments.body:
Hi @andersonsevla,

Thanks for this. In relation to another question that came up, do you think we need a full language code (like pt-BR) or is it sufficient to support simple two letter codes (like pt).

Please see this issue for context:
https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1175

Hi @tghosth 

Thanks for the question!

I understand that there can be some variation between pt-BR and pt-PT, especially in terminology or spelling. However, I’ll proceed with using the generic `pt` folder, as per the current convention in the repository.

Throughout the translation, I’ll do my best to use terminology that is broadly understandable in both variants of the Portuguese language. When possible, I’ll avoid region-specific terms or explain them clearly to ensure clarity for all Portuguese-speaking readers.

Happy to adapt if the project moves toward locale-specific codes in the future, but I believe `pt` will work well for now.

Thanks again!
Hi @andersonsevla, just to emphasise to make sure you base your translation on the [v5.0.0](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/tree/v5.0.0/5.0/en) branch and open a pull request against that branch.
@andersonsevla have you started working on this yet? I'd love to collaborate with the PT translation

Hi @tghosth , @andersonsevla , @julio-rocketchat !

I’m currently working on an academic project that involves translating and mapping the OWASP ASVS v5.0.0 requirements into Brazilian Portuguese.

I already have the translated requirements organized in a CSV file, following the exact same structure used for other ASVS 5.0.0 translations. Here is the link to my [CSV translation file](https://github.com/vhnogueira9/ASVS-translation_ptBR-csv/blob/main/OWASP_ASVS_v5_pt-BR.csv)

Since we need to follow the CONTRIBUTING.md guidelines and format these into Markdown files under the /5.0/pt directory, I’d love to team up and contribute.

Do you have an active fork or branch where I could start porting my CSV data into the .md files? Let me know how we can best collaborate on this!

I don't have an active fork nor branch, but if you create one, I'd definitely like to team up and contribute as well.

Hi @julio-rocketchat !

Since there wasn't an active fork or branch yet, I went ahead and set up the environment following the CONTRIBUTING.md guidelines so we can start working together.

I branched off from v5.0.0 and copied the 5.0/en folder to 5.0/pt. Furthermore, I added a CSV file (5.0/docs_pt/OWASP_ASVS_v5_pt-BR.csv) containing the requirements already translated to pt-BR to serve as a solid baseline for our work.

You can check out my branch [here](https://github.com/vhnogueira9/ASVS/tree/traducao-ptbr).

The environment is ready! Our next step is simply to move the translated text from the CSV into the respective .md files inside the 5.0/pt folder.

I can add you as a collaborator on my fork so we can push commits together. Let me know what you think!
